brief.title: Catch Me Up on Anything
brief.customer: Time-constrained product managers and startup founders who follow fast-moving technology topics.
brief.problem: Catching up on a topic means opening newsletters, product announcements, and discussion threads, often when reading is inconvenient.
brief.solution: Enter a topic and get a short, on-demand audio briefing with clickable sources and an emphasis on what changed recently.
brief.known: The founder has experienced the problem personally. No customer interviews, tracked repeat usage, or payment data have been collected.

assumptions.statement: Product managers and founders will request and use a second briefing when another topic comes up.
assumptions.reason: Repeat use would distinguish a recurring job from a one-time demo. The founder’s experience gives us a reason to test it.

assumptions.statement: Typing a topic to get researched audio without supplying documents is enough to differentiate the product.
assumptions.reason: A reason to switch matters. Existing product descriptions show overlap, while the quality and fit of those alternatives for this audience remain untested.

assumptions.statement: Audio generation can start with an existing service that converts a prepared script into a short briefing.
assumptions.reason: A documented service would remove the need to build a speech model. End-to-end speed, fidelity, and per-episode cost still need measurements.

assumptions.statement: Listeners in this segment will use source links to verify unfamiliar claims.
assumptions.reason: Links add verification value only when users can find and use them in a real listening session.

assumptions.statement: Repeat listeners will pay enough to cover the cost of researching and producing their briefings.
assumptions.reason: Revenue and cost determine whether a personalized service can be sustained. The demo has no price tests or production cost measurements.

sources.title: AnyPod · About
sources.passage: Just type what you want to learn, and we'll create a researched, original podcast on any topic.

sources.title: Google Gemini · Canvas and Audio Overview
sources.passage: Audio Overview transforms your documents, slides and even Deep Research reports into engaging, podcast-style audio discussions.

sources.title: Hints · On-demand podcasts
sources.passage: Tell Hints what to cover and get a custom episode generated for your exact interests and voice style.

sources.title: ElevenLabs · Speech synthesis introduction
sources.passage: ElevenLabs Text to Speech (TTS) API turns text into lifelike audio with nuanced intonation, pacing and emotional awareness.

links.reason: AnyPod describes the same topic-to-researched-audio flow. Its product page establishes the advertised overlap.
Gemini offers podcast-style audio for Deep Research reports. Research-to-audio already exists as an alternative.
Hints markets topic-driven custom audio. A more focused reason to switch needs testing with this audience.
An existing API supplies the script-to-audio step. Timing, sound quality, and price for this workflow remain to be measured.
Clickable citations are already an advertised feature. The page supplies a design precedent and gives no data on listener verification behavior.

experiment.title: Run a one-week concierge pilot for repeat listening
experiment.procedure: Recruit eight PMs or founders who research emerging technology topics at least twice a week. Give each the same request link and make their first requested briefing by hand. Leave the link available for seven days without reminders. Record follow-up requests and whether those listeners play at least half of the second briefing, with their consent.
experiment.metric: Number of participants who independently request and listen to at least half of a second briefing within seven days of their first.
experiment.threshold: Continue testing this audience if at least 4 of 8 participants qualify. Below 4, interview the non-returners before investing in automation.
experiment.cost: $0 in paid software for a manual pilot, excluding staff time and any participant incentives
